last.verdict: Investors liked the earnings beat and the higher profit floor, despite weak sales.

reasons.label: Beat expectations
reasons.text: Adjusted profit of 49 cents a share topped the roughly 40 cents analysts expected.

reasons.label: Profit outlook nudged up
reasons.text: Low end of 2026 profit guidance rose $500 million, to $10.5 billion–$11 billion.

reasons.label: Steady 2027 signal
reasons.text: Management expects 2027 profit about flat versus 2026, despite roughly $2 billion of cost pressure.

story: Ford has raised 2026 profit guidance at each report this year. Q1 got a one-time $1.3 billion tariff-refund boost and jumped over 6% after hours. Q2 rose about 6% but faded within a month. Rising metal costs and weak EV results remain the worries.
